versions.description: A daily door calendar for any season. From the start date (default Dec 1, 24 doors) players type `advent` once a day to open today's door and get its gift: currency, items and/or a role. The last door holds a bigger gift. Missed doors stay locked, except for players with the catch-up permission (VIP, optional limit). New doors are announced, players are reminded on join, and openings can be broadcast. Admins check the setup with `adventpreview [door]`. Reuse it for Halloween, anniversaries or any event by changing the start date, number of days and event name.

commands.name: advent
commands.description: Open today's door of the calendar.
commands.helpText: advent = open today's door. advent <door> = open a missed door (catch-up permission).

commands.name: adventpreview
commands.description: Admin: show the calendar setup or the gift of one door.
commands.helpText: adventpreview = dates and gifts overview. adventpreview <door> = gift of that door.

hooks.name: on-join
hooks.description: Deliver queued items and remind players of today's door.

cronJobs.name: announce
cronJobs.description: Broadcast once when a new door opens.

functions.name: advent-helpers

permissions.description: Open doors of past days with advent <door>. Count = how many missed doors per event (0 = no limit). Give it to VIPs.
Use adventpreview to check dates and the gift of every door.
